slides.title: Of course it feels that way.
slides.body: Nobody sends you a W-2 for school pickup, the doctor's appointments, the meals, the calendar, the 2 a.m. fevers.

slides.title: If she couldn't do it anymore, what would it [[cost]] to replace?

Not because her love has a price.
Because the [[work]] does.
slides.body: Life insurance on a non-earning parent is worth a real conversation. Coverage has a cost, underwriting, and tradeoffs, so compare options before you decide.

slides.title: Ask together:
items: What does she do in a week?
What would it cost to replace while the kids are home?
Is there any coverage on her right now?

slides.title:
Her work doesn't come with a paycheck.
It still holds [[everything]] together.
slides.body: Protect it like it matters, because it does.
slides.footnote: Educational only. Not individualized advice. Insurance guarantees depend on the claims-paying ability of the issuer; coverage is subject to underwriting.

story.title: Is there life insurance on the stay-at-home parent in your house?
You're not alone. It's one of the most common [[gaps]] in a family plan.
What would it actually cost to replace everything [[she]] does?

endcard.title: Protect it like it matters.
